name: blackswan-cot
description: The COT probe — the POSITIONING / FLOW signal class (the one class the program had not tested). CFTC Commitments-of-Traders MANAGED-MONEY net positioning (net = spec long - short, as a fraction of open interest) is an extreme-of-past signal with a real structural story: crowded speculators become FORCED unwinders on a reversal (a nameable counterparty). cot_contrarian FADES a crowded extreme (top-tail net-long -> short), cot_momentum RIDES it. Reuses the shared past-only extreme core (signal_extremes) + the intraday backtest, so every gate/lens reads a COT cell unchanged. The one surface new here is the COT JOIN, which carries the leakage trap pinned in test_cot.py: the COT measured on a Tuesday is PUBLISHED the following Friday, so a bar dated D reads only a report whose (report date + release_lag_days) is at/before D. The extreme is past-only, the position applies to the next bar, positions never read price. Gold's/silver's/copper's secular bull makes return_vs_hold exposure-biased, so signal_expectancy (per-trade edge) is the exposure-neutral decider alongside the DSR-deflated oos_sharpe gate. Deterministic and model-free (the seed is contract-only). DATA: cot/<ASSET>.json from scripts/fetch_cot.py (free CFTC Socrata API).

asset.description: Which metal is traded and whose CFTC COT managed-money positioning drives the signal. Each pairs its commodities/<ASSET> price with cot/<ASSET>.json. SPY/IEF/TLT are the cross-asset-class extension (equity / 10y notes / long bonds) using the TFF leveraged-funds cohort; their COT runs 2006-2022.

signal.description: cot_contrarian FADES a crowded net-positioning extreme (top-tail spec-long -> short, on the crowded-longs-unwind thesis); cot_momentum RIDES it. A bar fires only when its (release-lagged) net/OI is at/above the cot_pct quantile (or at/below 1-this) of its PAST-ONLY distribution. An unknown value is refused.

cot_pct.description: The quantile of the TRAILING (expanding, past-only) net-positioning distribution at/above which the reading is a crowded-long extreme (and at/below 1-this a crowded-short extreme). Computed only from readings observed at prior bars.

hold_bars.description: How many daily bars a position is held after an extreme, then flat (~2 weeks at 10; COT is weekly). The position earns bars t+1..t+hold_bars, and a new extreme inside the hold window is ignored.

release_lag_days.description: Publication lag: a report dated Tuesday D is usable only from D + release_lag_days. Default 4 covers the Friday release + weekend so the Monday bar uses it; a bar before that never sees the unpublished report. Larger values test robustness to conservative timing.

cot_index_window.description: 0 = the EXPANDING past-only quantile (anchored to all history — can be made unreachable by an old positioning mania). > 0 = a TRAILING-window COT INDEX (Williams min-max over the last N bars, e.g. 756 ~ 3yr) that adapts to regime and fires even when the level is nowhere near an all-time extreme.

min_history.description: Bars of trailing history required before the positioning extreme / COT index is computed (warms the distribution). Larger for the trailing COT index so its min-max normalisation is meaningful.

cot_flow_lag.description: 0 = signal on the positioning LEVEL. > 0 = signal on the FLOW (weekly CHANGE): value[t] - value[t-lag] (~5 bars = 1 week), i.e. WHICH WAY managed money is moving, a distinct signal from how extreme the level is. The extreme/side machinery then runs on the flow series.

transaction_fee.description: Per-side fee, charged on turnover at entry and again at exit (~0.1% round trip).

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample year is ACCOUNTED. A real positioning edge must hold in a MAJORITY of these five regime-diverse years, not one.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the backtest is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept.
